```{r}
### Determine the examplar genes for each factor/signature
factor = apply(ds$genesigs, 1, function(x) which.max(x))
ds$genesigs = cbind(factor,ds$genesigs)
rm(factor)

list.topGenes = lapply(2:ncol(ds$genesigs), function(f) {
  i = f-1
  print(i)
  temp = ds$genesigs[ds$genesigs[,1] == i,]
  distance = data.frame(dist = rep(0, nrow(temp)))
  temp = as.data.frame(cbind(distance, temp))
  
  featuresMatrix = temp[,3:dim(temp)[2]]
  
  dists <- apply(featuresMatrix, 1, function(gene_weights) {
    maxWeight = max(gene_weights)
    secMaxWeight = max(gene_weights[gene_weights < maxWeight])
    maxWeight - secMaxWeight
  })
  
  temp$dist <- dists
  temp = temp[order(-temp$dist), , drop = FALSE]
  feature.top250 = rownames(temp)[1:250]
  as.data.frame(c(feature.top250))
})
```

```{r}
# Initialize empty list to collect plots
plots <- list()

# Unique specimen types
specimen_types <- unique(data$info$SpecimenType)

# Define pairwise comparisons
my_comparisons <- list(c("EAC", "ESC"), c("ESC", "GAC"), c("EAC", "GAC"))

# Loop over each SpecimenType and create plot
for (stype in specimen_types) {
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    f01 = data$info$f01,
    TumorType = data$info$TumorType,
    SpecimenType = data$info$SpecimenType
  ) %>%
    filter(SpecimenType == stype)

  plot_data$TumorType <- factor(plot_data$TumorType)

  max_y <- max(plot_data$f01, na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = TumorType, y = f01, fill = TumorType)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, label.y = c(max_y * 1.05, max_y * 1.15, max_y * 1.25)) +
    stat_compare_means(label.y = max_y * 1.35) +  # Global p-value
    scale_fill_manual(values = ph.colors$TumorType) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("f01 by Tumor Type - Specimen Type: ", stype),
      y = "f01 Expression",
      x = "Tumor Type"
    )

  plots[[stype]] <- p
}

# Arrange all plots in a grid
plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 1)  # or ncol = 3 for side-by-side layout
#pdf 16 x 4
```

```{r}
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)

## All correlations with ESTIMATE
subset = data$info[data$info$TumorType!="ESC"& !is.na(data$info$TumorType) &data$info$SpecimenType!="C",]
phenotype = data.frame(row.names = rownames(subset), TumorType = c(subset$TumorType), SpecimenType = c(subset$SpecimenType))
samplesigs = data.frame(row.names = rownames(subset),sumf01f03 = c(subset$f01+subset$f03), f01 = c(subset$f01), f02 = c(subset$f02), f03 = c(subset$f03), f04 = c(subset$f04), f05 = c(subset$f05), f06 = c(subset$f06), f07 = c(subset$f07))
samplesigs = t(samplesigs)

## Tumor purity
p <- list()
for(i in 1:dim(samplesigs)[1]){
  df = data.frame(x=samplesigs[i,],y=subset$TumorPurity)
  p[[i]] <- ggscatter(df, x="x", y="y",
                      color = "gray",
                      add = "reg.line",
                      add.params = list(color = "blue", fill = "lightgray"),
                      conf.int = TRUE
   
   )+stat_cor(method = "pearson")
}
do.call(grid.arrange,p)

df = data.frame(x=samplesigs[1,],y=subset$TumorPurity)
p1=ggscatter(df, x="x", y="y",
                    color = "gray",
                    add = "reg.line",
                    add.params = list(color = "#E52521", fill = "lightgray"),
                    conf.int = TRUE
                    
)+stat_cor(method = "pearson")
p1 = p1+xlab("Sig.1+Sig.3")+ylab("ESTIMATE: Purity score")

## Stroma
p=NULL
p <- list()
for(i in 1:dim(samplesigs)[1]){
```

```{r}
##### Clustering with examplar genes
set.seed(235)

data$info = save.info

## derive examplar genes 2F's
genes.f1 = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[1]][1:50,]);colnames(genes.f1) = "genes"
genes.f2 = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[3]][1:50,]);colnames(genes.f2) = "genes"
#genes.f3 = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[5]][1:50,]);colnames(genes.f3) = "genes"
genes.f = rbind(genes.f1, genes.f2)
#genes.f = rbind(genes.f, genes.f3)

eset = data$expression_set
pl.eset = eset[,]
pl.eset = pl.eset[rownames(pl.eset) %in% genes.f$genes,]
pl.eset = pl.eset[match(genes.f$genes, rownames(pl.eset)),]
pl.eset = as.matrix(pl.eset)
pl.eset = t(scale(t(pl.eset)))
#pl.eset <- matrix(runif(50*30), nrow=50, ncol=30)
cc = ConsensusClusterPlus::ConsensusClusterPlus(pl.eset, pItem=0.8, pFeature = 1, reps = 500,distance = "euclidean", clusterAlg = "km",verbose = F, maxK=10, title = "mol.subtype",plot="pdf")
k=2
mol.subtype = cc[[k]]$consensusClass
mol.subtype[mol.subtype=="1"] = "IL"
mol.subtype[mol.subtype=="2"] = "ML"
dendrogram.order = cc[[k]]$consensusClass
dendrogram.order[cc[[k]]$consensusTree$order]=1:186
mol.subtype = cbind(mol.subtype, dendrogram.order)

data$info = merge(mol.subtype,data$info, by=0)
rownames(data$info) = data$info$Row.names
data$info$Row.names = NULL
data$info$dendrogram.order = as.numeric(data$info$dendrogram.order)

annotations = data.frame(row.names = rownames(data$info), dendrogram.order=data$info$dendrogram.order, mol.subtype=data$info$mol.subtype, TumorType=data$info$TumorType, SpecimenType=data$info$SpecimenType)

order = order(annotations$dendrogram.order)
annotations = annotations[order,]
pl.eset = pl.eset[,match(rownames(annotations),colnames(pl.eset))]

library(RColorBrewer)
cols <- c("darkblue","blue", "white","red","darkred")
newcol <- colorRampPalette(cols)
col_breaks = seq(from=-3,to=3,by=0.1)
ncols <- length(col_breaks)
cols2 <- newcol(ncols)#apply the function to get 100 colours

ph.colors= list(SpecimenType = c(B = "#4E79A7", R="#F28E2B",M = "#59A14F", C = "#EDC948"),
                TumorType = c(EAC = "#499894", ESC = "#E15759", GAC = "#79706E"),
                mol.subtype = c(IL = "#4E79A7", ML = "#E15759", `3` = "gray", `4` = "black"),
                f01= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Red-Gold")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f02= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Orange")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f03= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Blue-Green Sequential")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f04= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Green")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f05= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Brown")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f06= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Blue")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f07= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Purple")(seq(0, 1, length = 100)))
                )
p=pheatmap(pl.eset,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         show_rownames = F,
         show_colnames = F,
         breaks=col_breaks,
         annotation_col = annotations,
         annotation_colors = ph.colors,
         cols2)
#pdf("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/heatmap.sig1+3.allSamples.16MAR2023.pdf", height = 4.66, width = 9.15)
```

```{r}
## derive examplar genes 2F's
genes.f1 = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[1]][1:50,]);colnames(genes.f1) = "genes"
genes.f2 = as.data.frame(list.topGenes[[3]][1:50,]);colnames(genes.f2) = "genes"
genes.f = rbind(genes.f1, genes.f2)

eset = as.matrix(data$expression_set)
pl.eset = eset[,data$info$TumorType!="ESC"&!is.na(data$info$TumorType) ]
pl.eset = pl.eset[rownames(pl.eset) %in% genes.f$genes,]
pl.eset = pl.eset[match(genes.f$genes, rownames(pl.eset)),]
pl.eset = as.matrix(pl.eset)
pl.eset = t(scale(t(pl.eset)))
cc = ConsensusClusterPlus::ConsensusClusterPlus(pl.eset, pItem=0.8, pFeature = 1, reps = 500,distance = "euclidean", clusterAlg = "km",verbose = F, maxK=10, seed=123, title = "mol.subtype.adeno",plot="pdf")
k=2
mol.subtype.adeno = cc[[k]]$consensusClass
mol.subtype.adeno[mol.subtype.adeno=="1"] = "IL"
mol.subtype.adeno[mol.subtype.adeno=="2"] = "ML"
dendrogram.order.adeno = cc[[k]]$consensusClass
dendrogram.order.adeno[cc[[k]]$consensusTree$order]=1:dim(pl.eset)[2]
mol.subtype.adeno = cbind(mol.subtype.adeno, dendrogram.order.adeno)

data$info = merge(mol.subtype.adeno,data$info, by=0, all.y=T)
rownames(data$info) = data$info$Row.names
data$info$Row.names = NULL
data$info$dendrogram.order.adeno = as.numeric(data$info$dendrogram.order.adeno)

subset = data$info[data$info$TumorType!="ESC"&!is.na(data$info$TumorType),]
annotations = data.frame(row.names = rownames(subset), dendrogram.order.adeno=subset$dendrogram.order.adeno, mol.subtype.adeno=subset$mol.subtype.adeno, TumorType=subset$TumorType, SpecimenType=subset$SpecimenType)

order = order(annotations$dendrogram.order.adeno)
annotations = annotations[order,]
pl.eset = pl.eset[,match(rownames(annotations),colnames(pl.eset))]

library(RColorBrewer)
cols <- c("darkblue","blue", "white","red","darkred")
newcol <- colorRampPalette(cols)
col_breaks = seq(from=-3,to=3,by=0.1)
ncols <- length(col_breaks)
cols2 <- newcol(ncols)#apply the function to get 100 colours

ph.colors= list(SpecimenType = c(B = "#4E79A7", R="#F28E2B",M = "#59A14F", C = "#EDC948"),
                TumorType = c(EAC = "#499894", ESC = "#E15759", GAC = "#79706E"),
                mol.subtype.adeno = c(IL = "#4E79A7", ML = "#E15759", `3` = "gray", `4` = "black"),
                f01= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Red-Gold")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f02= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Orange")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f03= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Blue-Green Sequential")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f04= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Green")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f05= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Brown")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f06= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Blue")(seq(0, 1, length = 100))),
                f07= c(tableau_seq_gradient_pal("Purple")(seq(0, 1, length = 100)))
                )
p=pheatmap(pl.eset,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         show_rownames = F,
         show_colnames = F,
         breaks=col_breaks,
         annotation_col = annotations,
         annotation_colors = ph.colors,
         cols2)
```

```{r}
sample.sigs = t(ds$samplesigs)
temp = sample.sigs
temp = temp[data$info$TumorType == "EAC" &
              data$info$SpecimenType != "C" & !is.na(data$info$TumorPercentage.Revised),]
sample.factor = apply(temp, 1, function(x) which.max(x))
for (i in 1:dim(sample.sigs)[2]) {
  print(i)
  
  distance = c(rep(0,nrow(temp)))
  temp = as.data.frame(cbind(temp, distance))
  colnames(temp)[dim(temp)[2]] = paste0("distance.f",i)
  featuresMatrix = temp[,1:dim(temp)[2]]
  for (g in 1:dim(featuresMatrix)[1]){
    Weight = featuresMatrix[g,i]
    MaxWeight = max(featuresMatrix[g,])
    dist = Weight - MaxWeight
    temp[g,dim(temp)[2]] = Weight - MaxWeight
    if (dist == 0) {
    maxWeight = sort(featuresMatrix[g,])[dim(featuresMatrix)[2]]
    secMaxWeight = sort(featuresMatrix[g,])[dim(featuresMatrix)[2]-1]
    dist = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
    temp[g,dim(temp)[2]] = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
    }
    
  }
}
temp = cbind(temp,sample.factor)
temp
```

```{r}
baseline.table = data.frame(
  data$info$labid1R2,
  data$info$NoBI.oesI,
  data$info$SpecimenType,
  data$info$MLscore,
  data$info$mol.subtype.adeno,
  data$info$f01,
  data$info$f03,
  data$info$OS.days.,
  data$info$Survival_event,
  data$info$Age_at_diagnosis,
  data$info$BMI,
  data$info$Gender,
  data$info$TumorType,
  data$info$HER2,
  data$info$SampleLocation,
  data$info$Tumor_location,
  data$info$Differentiation_grade,
  data$info$cT,
  data$info$cN,
  data$info$cM,
  data$info$R0_resection,
  data$info$pT,
  data$info$pN,
  data$info$pM,
  data$info$Neoadjuvant_treatment,
  data$info$Treatment_prior,
  data$info$Treatment_after,
  as.character(data$info$Mandard),
  data$info$Matched)

colnames(baseline.table) = c(
  "Sample.ID",
  "NoBI.oesI",
  "SpecimenType",
  "MLscore",
  "mol.subtype.adeno",
  "f01",
  "f03",
  "Survival.days",
  "Survival.status",
  "Age",
  "BMI",
  "Gender",
  "Histology",
  "HER2",
  "SampleLocation",
  "Tumorlocation",
  "Differentiation_grade",
  "cT",
  "cN",
  "cM",
  "R0_resection",
  "pT",
  "pN",
  "pM",
  "Neoadjuvant_treatment",
  "Treatment_prior",
  "Treatment_after",
  "Mandard",
  "Matched"
)

baseline.table = within(baseline.table, {
  Gender = as.factor(Gender)
  Histology = as.factor(Histology)
  HER2 = as.factor(HER2)
  SpecimenType = factor(SpecimenType, levels = c("B", "R", "M"))
  Differentiation_grade = recode(Differentiation_grade, "Moderate" = "Moderate", "Poorly" = "Poor",  "Undifferentiated" = "Poor", "Well/Moderate" = "Well",  "Moderate/Poorly" = "Moderate")
  Differentiation_grade = factor(Differentiation_grade, levels = c("Poor", "Moderate", "Well"))
  cT = factor(cT, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "x"))
  cT = recode(cT, "1" = "cT1", "2" = "cT2", "3" = "cT3", "4" = "cT4", "x" = "cTx")
  cN = factor(cN, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "x"))
  cN = recode(cN, "0" = "cN0", "1" = "cN1", "2" = "cN2", "3" = "cN3", "x" = "cNx")
  cM = factor(cM, levels = c("0", "1", "x"))
  cM = recode(cM, "0" = "cM0", "1" = "cM1", "x" = "cMx")
  R0_resection = factor(R0_resection, levels = c("0", "1"))
  R0_resection = recode(R0_resection, "0" = "R0", "1" = "R1")
  pT = factor(pT, levels = c("0","1", "2", "3", "4", "x"))
  pT = recode(pT, "0" = "pT0","1" = "pT1", "2" = "pT2", "3" = "pT3", "4" = "pT4", "x" = "pTx")
  pN = factor(pN, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3"))
  pN = recode(pN, "0" = "pN0", "1"= "pN1", "2"= "pN2", "3"= "pN3")
  pM = factor(pM, levels = c("0", "1"))
  pM = recode(pM, "0" = "pM0", "1" = "pM1")
  Neoadjuvant_treatment = recode(Neoadjuvant_treatment, "CROSS+SOX" = "CROSS", "PERFECT" = "CROSS+α-PD-L1", "TRAP" = "CROSS+α-HER2/3")
  Treatment_prior = recode(Treatment_prior, "CROSS+SOX" = "CROSS", "PERFECT" = "CROSS+α-PD-L1", "TRAP" = "CROSS+α-HER2/3")
  Treatment_after = recode(Treatment_after, "CROSS+SOX" = "CROSS", "PERFECT" = "CROSS+α-PD-L1", "TRAP" = "CROSS+α-HER2/3")
  Mandard = factor(Mandard, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))
  Mandard = recode(Mandard, "1" = "Mandard1", "2" = "Mandard2", "3" = "Mandard3", "4" = "Mandard4", "5" = "Mandard5")
                                 })
```

```{r}
annotCol.pie.synchronMet= melt(prop.table(table(subset.synchronMet$mol.subtype.adeno)))
colnames(annotCol.pie.synchronMet) = c("Group", "value")
annotCol.pie.synchronMet$value=annotCol.pie.synchronMet$value*100
annotCol.pie.synchronMet <- annotCol.pie.synchronMet %>% 
  arrange(desc(Group)) %>%
  mutate(prop = value / sum(annotCol.pie.synchronMet$value) *100) %>%
  mutate(ypos = cumsum(prop)- 0.5*prop )
annotCol.pie.synchronMet
p5=ggplot(annotCol.pie.synchronMet, aes(x="", y=value, fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
  coord_polar("y", start=0)+
  theme_void()+
  geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = paste0(round(value, 1),"%")), color = "black", size=6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(ML="#E15759", IL="#4E79A7"))
grid.arrange(p3, p4, p5, nrow=1)

#pdf("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/piecharts.subtypes.adenopats.cM0CrossandcM1.26MAY2023.pdf", height = 4, width = 6)
print(grid.arrange(p4, p5, nrow=1))
#dev.off()

subset = rbind(subset.metachronMet, subset.synchronMet)
table(subset$mol.subtype.adeno, subset$cM)
fisher.test(table(subset$mol.subtype.adeno, subset$cM))
```

```{r}
    }) %>%

m <- data$info %>%
  filter(TumorType!="ESC" & SpecimenType=="R") %>%
  within({
    Mandard = factor(Mandard, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))
  Mandard = recode(Mandard, "1" = "Mandard1", "2" = "Mandard2", "3" = "Mandard3", "4" = "Mandard4", "5" = "Mandard5")

MASS::polr(Mandard ~ MLscore, data=. , Hess=TRUE)
```
